performance_case.causal_mechanism: A create-only atomic one-way drop plus independently revalidated network-denied intake preserves point-in-time carry atoms without granting the canonical Worker network access or allowing source bytes to be rewritten.
performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance proves only an offline four-file transport and validation slice. It cannot prove Unix identity or mount enforcement, deployment, public endpoint reliability, canonical registration, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. A future reduction in adverse DRA entry path or maximum drawdown remains MISSING_PROOF until prospective carry atoms support a preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without a tested one-way boundary, the accepted producer core cannot lawfully deliver prospective carry atoms. This slice reduces time-to-evidence while avoiding premature wrapper, deployment and canonical integration work; failure preserves the disabled producer core.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The transport slice cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but trustworthy create-once delivery and independent intake validation reduce evidence-integrity failures and learning latency for accepting or rejecting the carry mechanism.
